title: Radarr
descript: Radarr is a movie collection manager. It watches release feeds, searches your indexers, sends chosen releases to a download client and imports and renames the finished files. This package runs the official LinuxServer.io Radarr image as a non-root container; its settings and database live in the application data folder, with /media for the library and /downloads for completed downloads. Open the app to add indexers, a download client and root folders.
important: Requires DockerEngine. No indexer/download client is included; add them in Settings, root folder /media, downloads /downloads. Data is in DockerAppData/radarrdocker; media/downloads are not shared with other apps. Radarr contacts the indexers and download clients you configure; no telemetry. See the privacy policy. Radarr is a trademark of its owner; this is an unofficial community package. Back up the folder before uninstalling. Plain HTTP on the LAN.
release_note: 6.4.4-2: added a privacy policy and a trademark/non-official statement; upgraded to the latest LinuxServer.io build (6.4.4.10685-ls326) for CVE remediation. Rectified per review comments C2, C3, C6, C8, T1.

data_notes: `config` holds the database, settings and logs; `media` is the movie library; `downloads` is where completed downloads land. Back up `config`; the media folders are your own files.
design_notes: **Runs as a non-root container.** Verified on real hardware as uid 1000.
**Three volumes.** `/config` keeps the database and settings; `/media` and `/downloads` give the app a library and a download folder inside its own application data directory.
**Health check** probes the web UI on container port 7878.
**Fixed image tag, never `:latest`**, Docker Hub only, no `privileged`, no `network_mode: host`, no Docker socket, no `cap_add`.

**Privacy and trademark.** Radarr contacts only the indexers/download clients you configure (no telemetry); `PRIVACY.md` documents this and is linked from Help. Radarr is a trademark of its owner, and this is an unofficial community package.
limitations: No download client and no indexer are included; add them in Settings.
`/media` and `/downloads` belong to this app only. They are not shared with the Deluge, Sonarr or Lidarr packages - each TOS Docker app has its own data folder.
The page is plain HTTP on the LAN; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
Docker applications cannot be upgraded in place in the App Center: updating means uninstalling and reinstalling, which keeps the data folder.
